After some positive feedback, I'm going to start making these posts every Friday, happy discussing! Here we go...

What is the Song of the Week (SOTW)?

The idea behind the SOTW is that one out of the absurd number of songs 311 has created will be posted every Friday for people to express their opinions on/have a chance to hear something they may have not heard before. Everyone is allowed to comment with their opinion on the song, sharing with each other what they personally believe is good or bad about it. It's important to note that the SOTW will cover all of 311's material, meaning that every song is possibility, and not just something officially released. Because of this, it's possible that a handful of people will have not heard the song selected for the week. In order to combat this, I will be posting a link of the song below.

Note: We only count your suggestion for next week if you also discuss the SOTW in your comment.

Basics/tl;dr of the above

New "Song of the Week (SOTW)" every Friday. A SOTW can cover any 311's material (b-sides, demos etc.). If you have not heard the SOTW before, you can find a video/link to the track below. You can freely comment your opinion regarding the SOTW. Suggest the next SOTW at the end of your post! (Not guaranteed to be selected)

SOTW: Down from Blue

Why not start with 311's biggest commercial hit? It is the first song on their third album, 311. It was their first #1 single on the Billboard Alternative Songs charts, and along with their self-titled album, was largely responsible for launching them into mainstream success. Down was the first song I ever listened to by 311 and the airy chorus had me hooked, along with the chunky breakdowns.
